family: IDEA000566; separate from 537/550/553/564/565 and all old glosses
authoring_class: Post-exposure exploratory construction, not a preregistered held test. Whole S/W scope preceded these meanings.

source.unit: Albertus De anima II.2.VIII, entire chapter, browser lines24-38
source.condensation: Two preserved-mediator cases only; chapter omissions fixed in decision.
source.source_status: Historical attributed mechanisms, not medical efficacy claims.
qualifications: Food is kept in one place until due alteration; cold's preservation is not identical with all spatial retention.
Wind-strength antecedent is preferred but frigiditas is a grammatically possible alternative; no new source certainty.
Wind availability does not imply strength; strong-wind guard remains independent.
Cold instances and case times are not identical across the cases.
No achieved event or net effect follows from PATH.

types.Case: A written owner/domain/time/background frame. S and W labels do not instantiate it.
types.ConditionKind: A quality kind, not an instantiated Condition.
types.Condition: A condition instance with written owner and case.
types.Carrier: A material bearer, e.g. food or wind; not itself a ResourceAspect.
types.Location: An explicitly identified place/container; no default body or nearest noun.
types.ResourceAspect: (bearer, relevant property, case), e.g. food usability or wind availability; no automatic Carrier-to-aspect cast.
types.ProcessConstructor: Finite ordered typed arguments plus Case yield a ProcessAspect.
types.ProcessAspect: An instantiated process with exact arguments and Case.
types.OperationAspect: An operation with owner and criterion.
types.Guard: A separately written qualification retained in a path.

qod.type: For any explicitly licensed ProcessConstructor P(args,k), qod(P) takes the SAME ordered args, then Condition c, within k.
qod.scope: Only exact whole forms qodaiin and qodain. No qod deletion or normalization elsewhere.

aiin.note: Does not encode heat, dissolution's full mechanism, cause, absence, amount or outcome.

ain.note: Not all motion and not a resource's power. Location precedes carrier by explicit convention.

or.note: A written frame must instantiate this kind; it does not alone supply a body or time.

odain.note: Opaque whole. Its letters ain do not license segmentation.

los.note: Explicit semantic synonym of odain: one extra free value, not a transcription alias.

chedy.note: Explicit synonym of an; not INHIBITS and no old gloss.

ar.note: Explicit synonym of an; not recipient, heat or faculty nominalizer.

grammar.rule: Only qod+aiin and qod+ain are licensed decompositions. The qod function preserves base argument identities, order, number and types, then adds Condition. All other forms remain whole and literal.

A bare process constructor may take its full ordered argument list immediately on its right (prefix) or immediately on its left (postfix). Both are generic licenses for both process roots; no discontinuous search or argument reordering. Line breaks may be crossed; selected paragraph boundaries may not. Ambiguous cases remain ambiguous.
grammar.cost: 2 application-order licenses. Prefix alone cannot own terminal S.17 ain; postfix alone cannot use preceding or:COLD_KIND as ain's Carrier at W.20.

grammar.rule: A qod compound takes all inherited arguments and then its Condition immediately on its right. An argument reference must resolve before application. Line breaks may be crossed; selected paragraph boundaries may not.
grammar.cost: 1 composite surface application rule; whole-block boundary rule. No silent subjects.

grammar.rule: Each reference searches only preceding explicitly introduced referents of its exact type within the same WRITTEN Case. Nearest compatible referent is used; absence or genuine tie is unresolved. No cross-block import, forward reference or implicit projection.
grammar.cost: 1 typed reference rule; 4 reference sorts. Seven independently assigned reference whole forms, including 3 synonym costs.

grammar.rule: A Case and its owner/time must be supplied by a written frame construction. No such frame construction has been completed in this partial. Target block IDs are accounting labels, not semantic frame words.
grammar.cost: Unfilled scope obligation, not a licensed zero-cost Case.

grammar.rule: No COLD_KIND-to-Condition or Carrier-to-ResourceAspect cast is automatic. A written condition-instantiation or aspect-owner expression is required. No such complete owner expression is supplied here.

INHIBITS is a local attributed influence. It licenses neither absence nor preservation success, and no PATH without DEPLETES, SUPPORTS and guard facts sharing EXACT intermediate arguments. C8 supplies only the lexical depletion aspect of LOSS, not the missing heat/dissolution explanation or any SUPPORTS fact.
grammar.cost: Semantic ceiling inherited from RAW566, not a target translation rule.

grammar.rule: As the explicit semantic analysis of DISSIPATIVE_LOSS, DEPLETES(DISSIPATIVE_LOSS(R;k),R,k) holds dispositionally: if that process operates, the affected usable aspect is depleted. Mentioning the process does not assert its occurrence. ESCAPE_FROM(l,x;k) does not automatically deplete any unspecified aspect of x.
grammar.cost: 1 lexical entailment law. This is not a written nutrient-dissolution clause and not a Carrier-to-ResourceAspect projection.

source_case_account.desired: Cold inhibits nutrient dissolution/dissipation; that process depletes the same usable nutrient aspect; that aspect supports retention under due alteration and place constraints.
source_case_account.written: K1 gives only an open inhibition-of-loss expression.
missing: Written retainer/body, nutrient, place and case/time frame
Heat-caused dissolution, not merely generic loss
Explicit link from the source's heat-caused nutrient dissolution to the same usable aspect; C8 covers only generic loss of R
SUPPORTS from the SAME aspect to spatial retention with due-alteration endpoint
Indirect/per-accidens status and preservation of essence/figure

source_case_account.desired: Cold inhibits wind escape; available wind may support expulsion with separate thickening and strength guard. Wind availability and strength are distinct.
source_case_account.written: K2 gives open inhibition of escape; K3 gives open inhibition of loss. Their resource identity is not yet linked.
missing: Written expeller/body, wind, surplus/location and case/time frame
A preceding cold Condition for K2
A written aspect-of link from K2's wind Carrier to K3's ResourceAspect
DEPLETES(escape,availability) plus SUPPORTS(availability,expulsion) with exact shared arguments
Separate thickening statement and strong-wind guard
Indirect/per-accidens status; intended/path versus achieved expulsion distinction

costs.note: No code-length or statistical compression claim. qod genuinely couples arguments/types, but the scope/owner/support grammar is still absent. No free replacements for the other 35 selected ZL whole types.

rivals.claim: May retain the same source dependencies while placing preservation before operation, potentially after cold ceases. No independence of downstream events assumed.
rivals.current_discrimination: No owned times/events or complete target discourse relation; not distinguished.

rivals.claim: Repeated qod might relate a process to a protective goal or topic rather than assert local inhibitory causation.
rivals.current_discrimination: The current source-guided assignments do not independently identify the word's causal relation.

rivals.claim: Can give each compound its own value.
rivals.current_discrimination: The proposed qod law is narrower: changes in root arguments/arity propagate to every compound. The IT mismatch is a genuine consequence of this candidate, not evidence that qod means inhibition.
